scripts.exports:mermaid: node analyze-exports.mjs --format mermaid --layout TD --output docs/export-graph.mmd && open docs/export-graph.mmd
scripts.exports:html: node analyze-exports.mjs --format html --tree --layout TD --output docs/export-graph.html && open docs/export-graph.html
scripts.exports:svg: node analyze-exports.mjs --format dot --output /tmp/export-graph.dot && dot -Tsvg /tmp/export-graph.dot -o docs/export-graph.svg && open docs/export-graph.svg
scripts.release:patch: npm run smoke && npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm run smoke && npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm run smoke && npm version major && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:tag: npm run smoke && npm publish --access public --tag ${npm_config_tag:-latest}
